McLaren: McLaren’s latest tweaks give the car a cleaner airflow package: a brand‑new front‑brake duct smooths the air hitting the front wheels, while a re‑shaped floor board and its “furniture” tighten the under‑body flow. The result is a noticeable boost in down‑force and stability, letting the driver carry more speed through the corners and hit the straights harder – exactly the edge needed to fight for podium spots this weekend.

Red Bull Racing: Red Bull has tweaked the rear‑wheel aero by adding a set of small winglets to the bodywork at the rear corner of the car. The extra surfaces help keep the rear more stable under heavy braking and high‑speed cornering, giving the drivers a bit more grip when they’re pushing the limits. In practice, that translates into better traction out of the slower turns and a higher chance of defending or attacking on the straights this weekend.
Scuderia Ferrari: Ferrari has enlarged the cooling inlets and outlets around the rear corner and reshaped the lower deflector, plus fine‑tuned the rear winglet cluster. The result is better airflow that keeps the power unit and brakes cooler while giving a slight boost in rear stability. In practice, this should help the car stay on the limit through fast corners and reduce the risk of overheating during this weekend’s race.
Williams Racing: Williams has fitted a brand‑new front wing this weekend, reshaping the main profile and endplates to smooth the airflow around the car. The tweak should boost front‑end grip and make the car more stable through corners, letting the drivers extract a little extra pace on a circuit that rewards clean aerodynamics. In short, a cleaner front wing means better handling and a better chance to fight higher up the grid.
Racing Bulls / RB: Racing Bulls has tweaked the car’s under‑floor and rear diffuser, reshaping the edges and adding a new forward‑deflector to smooth the airflow at the back. The result should be a steadier rear end with more grip, especially through high‑speed corners, giving the team a better chance to defend and attack on this weekend’s circuit.
